arguments.action: Seamless energetic full-body running cycle, facing east (screen right) in side profile throughout. Quickly enter an energetic running stride and complete one full left-right cycle, without slowing back to idle. Two distinct foot contacts and pushes, heels flick upward, knees lift through passing poses, hips twist opposite shoulders. IMPORTANT: both arms visibly swing through natural arcs, including the sword arm. Right shoulder leads, elbow bends and extends, wrist follows with a delayed swing; the rigid katana changes angle with the wrist and remains firmly attached to the grip, never frozen in space or rubbery. Free arm counter-swings. Long hair and coat tails flow behind the body's rise and fall with delayed settling. Character stays centered; fixed camera, no turning, no translation across canvas. Entire blade stays visible without clipping. Clear leg separation and body weight, no idle pause, no planted sword arm.
